pricing.note: Incremental direct-label route-template pricing over selected task sets. Negative columns are true-dual audited and addable diagnostics; no-column results are not exhaustive certificates.

objective_breakdown.note: Official objective is normalized additive operating cost, risk, and weighted completion. Makespan is reported as an evaluation metric only.

certificate_boundary: Negative columns are true-dual audited and exact-safe to add. This probe never certifies no-negative because selected task sets are not full-space coverage.
